1859: the sky turned red and telegraph wires caught fire. The Carrington Event 🌌

On September 1, 1859, Richard Carrington recorded the first solar flare. Hours later the strongest geomagnetic storm on record lit up skies as far south as Cuba and shocked telegraph operators.
